definition: Architectures and operating arrangements that integrate on-premises or private infrastructure with public cloud, or that use services from more than one cloud provider. Includes hybrid cloud architecture, multicloud architecture, cloud interconnection, unified identity and access, workload portability, common management, orchestration, policy enforcement, observability, container platforms, data synchronisation and placement of workloads across environments. Excludes use of several unrelated hosting providers without integrated architecture or governance, a single public cloud environment, and basic internet connectivity to a cloud provider. Disaster recovery in another environment is excluded unless the activity establishes a broader hybrid operating model.
